question: In a certain code language, SCHOOL is coded as the number 72. What number will FLOWER be coded as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8917e7e4a037fb946fafa0b16de664d6f0ce32ab76e5c2c9b848dc1f771a7f81.png] 

The logic followed here is:

SCHOOL is coded as the number 72

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ad142563d23efc9f8af6ed31e8b586cc70a7743e821796c9b7078dfc072d71f7.png] 

Similarly, **FLOWER **will be coded as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db6cdc165fea01675197c7567b0ebaee5756eea487925b601494423d2c6e96bb.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "79".
